top_online_stores.text:
Description: In fiscal year 2024, the cross-border e-commerce market in Japan with the United States and China was valued at around 441 billion Japanese yen. The two trade partners were the main markets for cross-border business-to-consumer (B2C) transactions
from Japan. In contrast, the domestic B2C e-commerce market was valued at over 26 trillion yen. Read more
Note(s): Japan; fiscal years 2016 to 2024; the Japanese fiscal year runs from April 1of the stated year to March 31 of the following year; products purchased from Chinese and U.S. online retailers only
Source(s): METI (Japan)

auctions and flea market platforms carrying the market growth. Read more

Rakuten Ichiba and Yahoo Shopping. Read more
Note(s): Japan; fiscal years 2014 to 2023; the Japanese fiscal year runs from April 1 of the stated year to March 31 of the following year

Description: In fiscal year 2023, the sales value of the e-commerce website designing service market in Japan amounted to around 213.4 billion Japanese yen. The market was forecast to increase steadily to almost 258 billion yen in fiscal 2027, boosted by businesses
shifting to online distribution channels and the integration of AI services. Read more

commerce market size of around 2.7 trillion yen. The segment was boosted by the digitalization of entertainment media. Read more
Note(s): Japan; 2024
Source(s): METI (Japan)
